documents.title: Study room hours
documents.text: The study room closes at 18:00 on weekdays. The room is closed on Sundays.

documents.title: Projector borrowing
documents.text: Members may borrow one projector for two days. Return it to the equipment desk.

documents.title: Room booking
documents.text: Book the meeting room at least 24 hours before a meeting. Each booking lasts up to two hours.

documents.title: Technical support
documents.text: For computer problems, email help@example.org. The support desk is in room 204.

documents.title: Safety equipment
documents.text: Wear safety glasses and gloves when handling chemicals. Food is not allowed in the wet laboratory.

documents.title: Seminar schedule
documents.text: The weekly research seminar starts on Tuesday at 14:00 in room 310.

documents.title: Temporary data
documents.text: Remove temporary experiment files after 30 days. Keep approved research records in the archive.

documents.title: Printing
documents.text: Each member may print 40 black and white pages per week. Color printing requires a separate request.
